scope: DFW suburbs (Collin, Denton, Rockwall, Kaufman, Ellis, Johnson counties)

records.name: North Texas Food Bank - Find Food
records.description_en: The food bank sends food to hundreds of partner pantries and mobile food events. It also helps people apply for SNAP food benefits.
records.description_es: El banco de comida envía alimentos a cientos de despensas y a eventos móviles de comida. También ayuda a las personas a solicitar SNAP (estampillas de comida).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone who needs food in the food bank's service area can use its pantry finder. Each pantry sets its own rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que necesite comida en el área del banco puede usar su buscador de despensas. Cada despensa pone sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find a Food Pantry tool on the website to find a pantry or mobile distribution near you. Call the SNAP line for help applying for food benefits.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la herramienta “Find a Food Pantry” en el sitio web para encontrar una despensa o un evento móvil cerca de usted. Llame a la línea de SNAP para recibir ayuda con su solicitud de beneficios de comida.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Sat 8:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m. (campus hours)
records.notes: Main office: Perot Family Campus, 3677 Mapleshade Lane, Plano. NTFB serves 12 North Texas counties. Its pantry finder sends residents of Denton, Johnson, and several other counties to the Tarrant Area Food Bank instead. SNAP and benefits help line: (214) 269-0906.

records.name: Tarrant Area Food Bank - Find Local Food (TAFB North)
records.description_en: The food bank supplies local food pantries across North Texas. Its online map helps you find a pantry near you, and staff can help you apply for SNAP.
records.description_es: El banco de comida surte a despensas locales en el norte de Texas. Su mapa en línea le ayuda a encontrar una despensa cerca, y el personal le puede ayudar a solicitar SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone who needs food. Each partner pantry sets its own rules and hours.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier persona que necesite comida. Cada despensa pone sus propias reglas y horarios.
records.how_to_apply: Search the Find Food map on the website, then call the pantry before you go to confirm days and hours. You can also book an appointment online with a Community Resource Specialist for help applying for SNAP.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque en el mapa “Find Food” del sitio web y llame a la despensa antes de ir para confirmar días y horarios. También puede hacer una cita en línea con un especialista para que le ayude a solicitar SNAP.
records.notes: TAFB North: 306 N. Loop 288, Ste. 113, Denton. TAFB West: 112 Winners Circle, Weatherford. Main office: 2600 Cullen Street, Fort Worth. Denton and Johnson County coverage is confirmed by the North Texas Food Bank pantry finder, which sends those counties to TAFB. Some pantry dates may be cancelled, so call ahead.

records.name: Minnie's Food Pantry Drive-Thru
records.description_en: A free drive-thru food pantry in Plano. It also has walk-up service for people who are homeless and a free clothing and household boutique.
records.description_es: Una despensa gratuita en Plano donde recoge la comida sin bajarse del carro. Las personas sin hogar pueden llegar a pie, y hay una tienda gratuita de ropa y artículos para el hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can use the drive-thru. There is no income test and no interview. The boutique is for low-income families and needs an intake appointment.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona puede usar el servicio desde el carro. No hay revisión de ingresos ni entrevista. La tienda de ropa es para familias de bajos ingresos y necesita una cita de registro.
documents_needed: Photo ID
Utility bill
records.how_to_apply: Drive up during open hours and bring a photo ID and a utility bill. People experiencing homelessness can walk up once a week.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llegue en carro durante el horario de atención con una identificación con foto y un recibo de servicios (luz, agua o gas). Las personas sin hogar pueden llegar a pie una vez por semana.
records.notes: Boutique is at 651 18th Street.

records.name: Frisco Family Services Market
records.description_en: A free grocery-store style food market with meat, dairy, fresh produce, and hygiene items. It also offers online order pickup and home delivery for people who cannot get there.
records.description_es: Un mercado gratuito de comida, como una tienda, con carne, lácteos, frutas y verduras frescas, y artículos de higiene. También puede pedir en línea y recoger, o recibir entrega a domicilio si no puede ir.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in Frisco or inside Frisco ISD and have a documented crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en Frisco o dentro del distrito escolar de Frisco (Frisco ISD) y tienen una crisis comprobada.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: City of Frisco or Frisco ISD resident

documents_needed: Photo ID for each applicant
Current lease or housing agreement
Official government ID for all household members
Recent household bills
Proof of your crisis (for example medical bills or police/fire reports)
Proof of income (for example pay stubs, unemployment notice, bank statements, or tax returns)
records.how_to_apply: Go to the office at 9111 Dogwood St. to fill out an application, or download it or apply online ahead of time. Turn it in with your documents to set up a meeting with a case manager.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina en 9111 Dogwood St. para llenar una solicitud, o descárguela o llénela en línea antes. Entréguela con sus documentos para hacer una cita con un trabajador social.
records.notes: Market is at 9085 Dogwood St.; applications are handled at the office at 9111 Dogwood St. Spanish info by phone at 972-335-9495. Market Express (online order, curbside pickup) and Mobile Market (home delivery for seniors and people without transportation) are available. Outside Frisco ISD, dial 2-1-1.

records.name: The Samaritan Inn Food Pantry
records.description_en: A grocery-store style food pantry in McKinney, plus Saturday drive-through mobile food events with staples, meat, and dairy.
records.description_es: Una despensa en McKinney donde usted escoge su comida, como en una tienda. Los sábados también hay entregas desde el carro con alimentos básicos, carne y lácteos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the pantry's service area of north and east Collin County towns, including McKinney, Anna, Celina, Melissa, Princeton, Prosper, and others.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en los pueblos del norte y este del condado de Collin que cubre la despensa, como McKinney, Anna, Celina, Melissa, Princeton, Prosper y otros.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Live in a listed Collin County service-area town (e.g., McKinney, Anna, Celina, Princeton, Prosper)

documents_needed: Photo ID
Proof of current address (lease or utility bill; a phone photo is OK; not needed if homeless)
records.how_to_apply: New clients can apply in person during pantry hours, Tuesday through Friday.
records.how_to_apply_es: Los clientes nuevos pueden inscribirse en persona durante el horario de la despensa, de martes a viernes. Traiga una identificación con foto y prueba de domicilio.
records.notes: Full town list: Anna, Altoga, Blue Ridge, Celina, Copeville, Farmersville, Josephine, Lavon, Lowry Crossing, McKinney, Melissa, Nevada, New Hope, Princeton, Prosper, Van Alstyne, Westminster, Weston. Saturday mobile drive-throughs: First Christian Church McKinney (1st Sat, 9-10:30 a.m.), First United Methodist Church (2nd and 4th Sat, 9:30-11 a.m.), McKinney First Baptist Church (3rd Sat, 9-11 a.m.).

records.name: CCA Food Market and Family Services
records.description_en: A choice food market with groceries, milk, meat, produce, hygiene items, and diapers. CCA also offers limited utility help, career coaching, and counseling.
records.description_es: Un mercado de comida donde usted escoge sus productos: abarrotes, leche, carne, frutas y verduras, artículos de higiene y pañales. CCA también da ayuda limitada con los recibos de servicios, orientación para el trabajo y consejería.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in Denton County, Coppell ISD, or Frisco ISD and meet CCA's income rules. Emergency food is given the same day to eligible residents.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Denton, Coppell ISD o Frisco ISD y cumplen con los límites de ingresos de CCA. A los residentes que califican se les da comida de emergencia el mismo día.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Denton County, Coppell ISD, or Frisco ISD resident

documents_needed: Photo ID for all adults
ID for all children (birth certificate or Social Security card)
Proof of all adult income for the last month
Copy of lease
Current utility bill or mail showing address
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Family Services office in Lewisville to sign up. Financial help requires joining a CCA program and filling out the online request form; walk-in requests for money are not accepted.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina de Servicios Familiares en Lewisville para inscribirse. Para ayuda con dinero, primero debe entrar a un programa de CCA y llenar el formulario en línea; no se aceptan solicitudes de dinero sin cita.
records.hours: Family Services: Mon-Fri 9-11 a.m. and Mon-Thu 1-3 p.m.
records.notes: CCA no longer gives general rent or mortgage help. Weekly market visits require attending one class, workshop, or approved activity. Answers to online financial help requests usually come within 7 business days.

records.name: Denton Community Food Center
records.description_en: An independent nonprofit food pantry in Denton that gives food to families and people facing hunger.
records.description_es: Una despensa independiente y sin fines de lucro en Denton que da comida a familias y personas que pasan hambre.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Denton-area families and individuals who need food. Appointments are required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias y personas del área de Denton que necesitan comida. Se necesita cita.
records.how_to_apply: Make an appointment, then park in the marked area and come inside for food. For after-hours emergency help, dial 2-1-1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga una cita, luego estaciónese en el área marcada y entre por su comida. Para ayuda de emergencia fuera del horario, marque 2-1-1.
records.hours: Mon and Wed 10:30 a.m.-12:15 p.m. by appointment only; select Saturdays 9:30-11:00 a.m. by appointment
records.notes: The website did not list a direct phone number; it points to 2-1-1 for after-hours emergencies. Saturday dates change; check the website.

records.name: Our Daily Bread Day Shelter and Meals
records.description_en: A day shelter in Denton that serves free lunch and dinner every day. It also offers showers, a hygiene closet, clothing and prescription help, mail service, phone and computer access, and shelter programs focused on finding housing.
records.description_es: Un refugio de día en Denton que sirve almuerzo y cena gratis todos los días. También ofrece regaderas, artículos de higiene, ayuda con ropa y medicinas, servicio de correo, teléfono y computadoras, y programas de refugio para ayudarle a encontrar vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who are homeless or at risk of homelessness in Denton County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas sin hogar o en riesgo de quedarse sin hogar en el condado de Denton.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during day shelter hours (every day, 10 a.m.-7 p.m.).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llegue sin cita durante el horario del refugio de día (todos los días, de 10 a.m. a 7 p.m.).
records.hours: Day shelter daily 10 a.m.-7 p.m.; lunch daily 11:30 a.m.-1 p.m.; dinner daily 5:30-6:30 p.m.
records.notes: Also runs a Housing Focused Shelter Program and an inclement weather shelter. Showers must be done by 6:30 p.m. Clothing vouchers weekdays 1-2:30 p.m.; prescription help weekdays 8 a.m.-4 p.m.; phone and computer access weekdays 9 a.m.-3 p.m.

records.name: Span Meals on Wheels of Denton County
records.description_en: Delivers hot, healthy meals to homebound seniors, disabled veterans, and people with disabilities. It also helps seniors get pet food.
records.description_es: Lleva comidas calientes y saludables a personas mayores que no pueden salir de casa, veteranos con discapacidad y personas con discapacidad. También ayuda a personas mayores a conseguir comida para sus mascotas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homebound seniors, disabled veterans, and people with disabilities in Denton County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores que no pueden salir de casa, veteranos con discapacidad y personas con discapacidad en el condado de Denton.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Meals Client Application on the Span website or call (940) 382-2224.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de comidas (Meals Client Application) en el sitio web de Span o llame al (940) 382-2224.
records.notes: Cost and detailed eligibility rules were not listed on the website; call to ask. Email: span@span-transit.org. Senior PAWS program helps seniors with pet food.

records.name: The Samaritan Inn Housing Program (Shelter)
records.description_en: A shelter and housing program in McKinney for men, women, and families who are homeless. Residents get caseworker meetings, counseling, job readiness help, and money classes.
records.description_es: Un refugio y programa de vivienda en McKinney para hombres, mujeres y familias sin hogar. Los residentes reciben reuniones con un trabajador social, consejería, ayuda para prepararse para el trabajo y clases sobre dinero.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homeless adults and families who can pass a drug test, pass a background check, and work full-time (part-time if disabled).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos y familias sin hogar que pasen una prueba de drogas, una revisión de antecedentes y trabajen tiempo completo (medio tiempo si tienen una discapacidad).
documents_needed: Government-issued ID
Social Security cards for adults and children
Birth certificates for children
records.how_to_apply: Come to an intake interview, first come first served, on Tuesday, Thursday, or Sunday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.
records.how_to_apply_es: Venga a una entrevista de ingreso, por orden de llegada, los martes, jueves o domingos de 8 a.m. a 1 p.m.
records.hours: Intake interviews Tue, Thu, Sun 8:00 a.m.-1:00 p.m.
records.notes: Must be drug- and alcohol-free for 30 days before intake. People with violent offenses may not be admitted (older than 10 years reviewed case by case). Limited kennel space for dogs; call ahead.

records.name: The Samaritan Inn Emergency Rent and Utility Assistance
records.description_en: Limited help paying Atmos, NRG-affiliate, and TXU utility bills. The program also offers current-month rent help for Collin County residents when funds are available, but rent applications are closed right now.
records.description_es: Ayuda limitada para pagar recibos de Atmos, empresas de NRG y TXU. El programa también ayuda con la renta del mes actual para residentes del condado de Collin cuando hay fondos, pero ahora las solicitudes de renta están cerradas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Samaritan Inn service area facing hardship (rent help is for Collin County residents). Money is limited and help is not guaranteed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área de servicio de The Samaritan Inn que pasan por un momento difícil (la ayuda de renta es para residentes del condado de Collin). El dinero es limitado y la ayuda no está garantizada.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online utility assistance form on the Samaritan Inn Emergency Financial Services page. Email Assistance@saminn.org with questions.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario en línea de ayuda con servicios en la página de servicios financieros de emergencia de The Samaritan Inn. Si tiene preguntas, escriba a Assistance@saminn.org.
records.notes: As of 2026-09-26 the rent assistance application was CLOSED; the utility assistance application was open. Only current-month rent is covered when rent help reopens.

records.name: Frisco Family Services Emergency Financial Assistance
records.description_en: Helps families stay in their homes and keep utilities on. Payments go straight to landlords, utility companies, and others. Can also help with prescriptions.
records.description_es: Ayuda a las familias a quedarse en su casa y mantener sus servicios conectados. Los pagos van directo al dueño de la vivienda, a la compañía de servicios y a otros. También puede ayudar con medicinas recetadas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in the city of Frisco or Frisco ISD and have a documented crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en la ciudad de Frisco o en Frisco ISD y tienen una crisis comprobada.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: City of Frisco or Frisco ISD resident

documents_needed: Photo ID for each applicant
Current lease or housing agreement
Official government ID for all household members
Recent household bills
Proof of your crisis (for example medical bills or police/fire reports)
Proof of income (for example pay stubs, unemployment notice, bank statements, or tax returns)
records.how_to_apply: Pick up, download, or fill out the application online, then bring it with your documents to the office to schedule a case manager appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Recoja, descargue o llene la solicitud en línea. Luego llévela con sus documentos a la oficina para hacer una cita con un trabajador social.
records.notes: People outside Frisco ISD are told to dial 2-1-1 or visit 211texas.org.

records.name: Plano Housing Authority - Housing Choice Voucher and Public Housing
records.description_en: Runs Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8), VASH vouchers for veterans, and low-rent public housing in Plano. People join a waiting list.
records.description_es: Maneja vales de vivienda (Sección 8), vales VASH para veteranos y vivienda pública de renta baja en Plano. Las personas se anotan en una lista de espera.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. Low-rent public housing only has 3- and 4-bedroom homes, so it is for households of 5 or more.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos. La vivienda pública solo tiene casas de 3 y 4 recámaras, así que es para hogares de 5 personas o más.
records.how_to_apply: Check the Waiting Lists tab on the website to see when applications open. Update your application every Jan 15-Feb 15 and Jul 15-Aug 15 or you will be dropped.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise la sección de listas de espera (Waiting Lists) en el sitio web para ver cuándo se abren las solicitudes. Actualice su solicitud cada año del 15 de enero al 15 de febrero y del 15 de julio al 15 de agosto, o lo sacarán de la lista.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8:00 a.m.-6:30 p.m.; Fri closed (lobby closed to public; appointments only)
records.notes: TDD/TTY: 800-545-1833. Waitlist info is not given by phone; check status online or by appointment. A document drop box is at the front door.

records.name: McKinney Housing Authority
records.description_en: The public housing agency for McKinney. It offers affordable housing for low-income residents.
records.description_es: La agencia de vivienda pública de McKinney. Ofrece vivienda a precio accesible para residentes de bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. Contact the office for current programs and waitlist status.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos. Comuníquese con la oficina para saber qué programas hay y si la lista de espera está abierta.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email the office to ask about open waiting lists.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un correo a la oficina para preguntar por las listas de espera abiertas.
records.notes: Email: info@mckinneyha.org. Program details were not listed on the pages reviewed.

records.name: Denton County Friends of the Family - Emergency Shelter and Crisis Line
records.organization: Denton County Friends of the Family
records.description_en: Free help for survivors of domestic violence, rape, and sexual abuse. Services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, counseling, and legal advocacy.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratuita para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, violación y abuso sexual. Ofrece refugio de emergencia, vivienda temporal, consejería y apoyo legal.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people affected by domestic violence, sexual assault, or abuse in Denton County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas afectadas por violencia doméstica, agresión sexual o abuso en el condado de Denton.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text the 24-hour crisis line at 940-382-7273. All clients do an intake to see what help they need. In an emergency, call 9-1-1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un mensaje de texto a la línea de crisis de 24 horas al 940-382-7273. Todos los clientes hacen una entrevista para ver qué ayuda necesitan. En una emergencia, llame al 9-1-1.
records.notes: Address is the Denton outreach office; shelter location is confidential.

records.name: Hope's Door New Beginning Center - Shelter and Hotline
records.description_en: Free and private help for survivors of domestic abuse and their children, including emergency shelter, counseling, legal help, and safety planning.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratuita y confidencial para sobrevivientes de abuso doméstico y sus hijos, con refugio de emergencia, consejería, ayuda legal y un plan de seguridad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of intimate partner or family violence in North Texas, including Collin County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para sobrevivientes de violencia de pareja o familiar en el norte de Texas, incluido el condado de Collin.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline any day. Outreach services are also offered at the Plano office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas cualquier día. También hay servicios en la oficina de Plano.
records.hours: Hotline and shelters 24 hours a day, every day. Plano office: Mon-Sat 10 a.m.-5 p.m., Sun 12-5 p.m.
records.notes: Plano address is the outreach office and resale store (972-769-0610). Main office: 218 N. 10th Street, Garland (972-422-2911, Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-5 p.m.). Coverage beyond Collin County not confirmed for this region file.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Texoma Council of Governments
records.organization: Texoma Council of Governments (TCOG) Energy Services
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. This is the local CEAP provider for Collin, Denton, and Rockwall counties.
records.description_es: Ayuda a hogares de bajos ingresos a pagar la luz, el gas y el propano. Es el proveedor local de CEAP para los condados de Collin, Denton y Rockwall.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households at or below 150% of the federal poverty level living in Collin, Cooke, Denton, Fannin, Grayson, Hunt, or Rockwall County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos de hasta el 150% del nivel federal de pobreza que viven en los condados de Collin, Cooke, Denton, Fannin, Grayson, Hunt o Rockwall.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Collin, Denton, or Rockwall County resident (also Cooke, Fannin, Grayson, Hunt)

documents_needed: Proof of income for all household members 18+ for the last 30 days
Current electric, gas, or propane bills
Proof of citizenship for all household members
Government-issued photo ID for adults 18+
Completed application packet
records.how_to_apply: Download the application packet. Mail it to 1117 Gallagher Dr., Suite 200, Sherman, TX 75090, or drop it off in Plano at 900 East Park Blvd., Suite 155. Applications are not accepted by email, online, or fax.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue el paquete de solicitud. Envíelo por correo a 1117 Gallagher Dr., Suite 200, Sherman, TX 75090, o déjelo en Plano en 900 East Park Blvd., Suite 155. No se aceptan solicitudes por correo electrónico, en línea ni por fax.
records.notes: Applications go on a wait list (average processing about 8 weeks); you are told by mail or email when yours is pulled. Energy Services ext. 3541; email energyapp@tcog.com. Example limit: 150% FPL = $49,500 for a family of 4.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Texas Neighborhood Services
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. This is the local CEAP provider for Johnson County.
records.description_es: Ayuda a hogares de bajos ingresos a pagar la luz, el gas y el propano. Es el proveedor local de CEAP para el condado de Johnson.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Erath, Hood, Johnson, Palo Pinto, Parker, Somervell, or Wise County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Erath, Hood, Johnson, Palo Pinto, Parker, Somervell o Wise.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Johnson County resident (also Erath, Hood, Palo Pinto, Parker, Somervell, Wise)

documents_needed: Signed SAVE form
Housing and Utility Supplement form
Birth certificate, passport, or immigration document for each household member
Photo ID for adults 18+
Proof of income for last 30 days (or Declaration of Income form)
Most recent utility bill
Benefit letters (Social Security, SSI, VA, child support, etc.) if any
Two IDs for children (e.g., school records, Social Security card)
records.how_to_apply: Apply 24/7 through the online Utility Assistance Portal and upload your documents. You can also email the application to application@txns.org, mail it, or drop it in the lock box at the Weatherford office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite a cualquier hora en el portal en línea de ayuda con servicios y suba sus documentos. También puede mandar la solicitud a application@txns.org, enviarla por correo o dejarla en el buzón de la oficina en Weatherford.
records.notes: Phone is (817) 598-5700 ext. 1010. Office hours were not listed on the website.

records.name: Energy Assistance (CEAP) - Economic Opportunity Advancement Corporation
records.description_en: Short-term help with electric and gas bills, plus home weatherization. This is the CEAP provider for Ellis County.
records.description_es: Ayuda por poco tiempo para pagar la luz y el gas, y arreglos en casa para ahorrar energía. Es el proveedor de CEAP para el condado de Ellis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households at or below 150% of the federal poverty guidelines in McLennan, Bosque, Freestone, Limestone, Hill, Falls, Ellis, or Navarro County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos de hasta el 150% de las guías federales de pobreza en los condados de McLennan, Bosque, Freestone, Limestone, Hill, Falls, Ellis o Navarro.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Ellis County resident (or other EOAC counties)

documents_needed: Completed application for the current program year
Citizenship or immigration papers for all household members
Photo ID for each household member 18+
Proof of income for the past 30 days for all adults 18+
Current electric and gas bills (front and back)
records.how_to_apply: Download the application and mail, fax, or drop it off. Applications are not accepted by email.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud y envíela por correo, por fax o entréguela en persona. No se aceptan solicitudes por correo electrónico.
records.notes: Office is in Waco. Weatherization also covers Johnson County (apply online, by phone, fax, or email). Kaufman County's CEAP provider is Greater East Texas CAP (800-621-5746), per Community Services, Inc.

records.name: Community Services Block Grant Case Management (CSBG)
records.description_en: Case management to help low-income families become self-sufficient. It can include rent help, job and school support, money coaching, and transportation resources.
records.description_es: Un trabajador social le ayuda a su familia a salir adelante por su cuenta. Puede incluir ayuda con la renta, apoyo para el trabajo y la escuela, orientación sobre dinero y recursos de transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of CSI's 10-county area, including Collin, Denton, Ellis, Kaufman, and Rockwall, who are at or below 125% of the federal poverty level.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de los 10 condados que cubre CSI, incluidos Collin, Denton, Ellis, Kaufman y Rockwall, con ingresos de hasta el 125% del nivel federal de pobreza.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Anderson, Collin, Denton, Ellis, Henderson, Hunt, Kaufman, Navarro, Rockwall, or Van Zandt County

documents_needed: Photo ID
Social Security card
Proof of household income (recent pay stubs or benefit letters such as SSI, pension, unemployment, or workers' comp)
records.how_to_apply: Download the 2026 application and turn it in with all documents. Applications are accepted ONLY on October 5, 2026. Call 903-872-2401 with questions.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud 2026 y entréguela con todos sus documentos. Las solicitudes se aceptan SOLO el 5 de octubre de 2026. Si tiene preguntas, llame al 903-872-2401.
records.notes: IMPORTANT: 2026 applications will be accepted ONLY on October 5, 2026; incomplete applications are not processed. Toll-free 1-800-831-9929; email support@csicorsicana.org. CSI does not run utility assistance; it refers to TCOG (Collin, Denton, Rockwall), EOAC (Ellis), and Greater East Texas CAP (Kaufman).

records.name: Child Care Services Scholarships
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay for child care so parents can work, look for work, or go to school or job training.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, buscar trabajo, estudiar o recibir capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in the 14-county area (including Collin, Denton, Ellis, Johnson, Kaufman, Rockwall) with a child from birth through age 12, or through 18 with a documented disability. Parents must work or be in school or training at least 25 hours a week (50 combined for two parents). Families looking for work or experiencing homelessness may qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias en el área de 14 condados (incluidos Collin, Denton, Ellis, Johnson, Kaufman y Rockwall) con un niño desde recién nacido hasta los 12 años, o hasta los 18 si tiene una discapacidad comprobada. Los padres deben trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse al menos 25 horas por semana (50 horas entre los dos si son dos padres). Familias que buscan trabajo o que no tienen hogar pueden calificar.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Collin, Denton, Ellis, Erath, Hood, Hunt, Johnson, Kaufman, Navarro, Palo Pinto, Parker, Rockwall, Somervell, or Wise County

documents_needed: Proof of county residency
Proof of U.S. citizenship or legal immigration status for each child (birth certificate, I-551, etc.)
Pay stubs for the last 13 weeks for all working household members
School/training information for adults (school name, hours enrolled, transcript)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online for a Child Care Scholarship through the Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas website.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea una beca de cuidado de niños desde el sitio web de Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas.
records.notes: Job search support is limited to 3 months. Family assets must not exceed $1 million. Full-time college-only parents limited to 60 months total unless also working.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - McKinney Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including evictions and landlord problems, family law, public benefits, and consumer issues.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como desalojos y problemas con el dueño de la vivienda, asuntos de familia, beneficios públicos y problemas de consumidor.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people with a civil (not criminal) legal problem who live in or have a case in a county served. You likely qualify if you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or live in public housing.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos con un problema legal civil (no penal) que viven o tienen un caso en un condado que cubre la oficina. Es probable que califique si recibe SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC o vive en vivienda pública.
records.how_to_apply: Call the local office during intake hours, call the Legal Aid Line at 888-529-5277, or apply online. Call the local office if you have a court deadline or were served with a lawsuit.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina local en su horario de admisión, llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 888-529-5277, o solicite en línea. Llame a la oficina local si tiene una fecha límite en la corte o si le entregaron una demanda.
records.notes: Also serves Fannin, Grayson, Hunt. Toll-free: 866-511-8018. Evening civil legal clinics in Allen, Plano, Rockwall and other towns; eviction clinics in Plano on Thursdays. Landlord-tenant line: 855-548-8457.

records.name: DCTA Reduced Fare Program
records.description_en: Lower fares on DCTA buses, the A-train, and shared rides for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare cardholders, and students. Children 5 and under ride free.
records.description_es: Pasajes más baratos en los autobuses de DCTA, el A-train y los viajes compartidos para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad, personas con Medicare y estudiantes. Los niños de 5 años o menos viajan gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For seniors 65+, people with disabilities, Medicare cardholders, and students ages 6 to 18 with a student ID.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidad, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y estudiantes de 6 a 18 años con identificación escolar.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the DCTA Reduced Fare application (English, Spanish, or Hakha Chin) to get a Reduced Fare Eligible badge, or call 940-243-0077. Then buy reduced fare passes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de pasaje reducido de DCTA (en inglés, español o hakha chin) para recibir una credencial, o llame al 940-243-0077. Después compre sus pases con descuento.
records.notes: The badge is not a pass by itself; you still need a paid fare.

records.name: Collin County Rides (Senior and Disabled Mobility)
records.description_en: Shared rides by appointment in minivans, including wheelchair-accessible vans, for trips within Collin County such as medical appointments.
records.description_es: Viajes compartidos con cita en minivans, incluidas unidades para sillas de ruedas, dentro del condado de Collin, por ejemplo para ir al médico.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For permanent residents of Allen or Fairview who are 65 or older or have a qualifying disability.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes permanentes de Allen o Fairview que tengan 65 años o más o una discapacidad que califique.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or download the application form. Once approved, book rides in the RideDCTA app or by phone at least one day ahead.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea o descargue el formulario. Cuando lo aprueben, reserve sus viajes en la app RideDCTA o por teléfono, por lo menos un día antes.
records.hours: Service Mon-Fri 6:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m.; phone reservations Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m., Sat 8 a.m.-3:45 p.m.
records.cost: Discounted: 75% off the first $125 spent each month; card payment only
records.notes: Riders qualify by age 65+ OR a qualifying disability. Trips must start or end in Allen or Fairview and stay within Collin County. Book 1 to 7 days ahead; no same-day rides. Pay by credit/debit card only (no cash). Proof of residency may be required.

records.name: DART Reduced Fare GoPass Tap Card
records.description_en: A 50% discount on DART buses, trains, and TRE. DART serves Plano in Collin County.
records.description_es: Un 50% de descuento en autobuses, trenes y el TRE de DART. DART da servicio en Plano, en el condado de Collin.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans, seniors 65+, people with disabilities, children 5-14, high school students, and full-time college or trade school students.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos, personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidad, niños de 5 a 14 años, estudiantes de preparatoria y estudiantes de tiempo completo de universidad o escuela técnica.
records.how_to_apply: Apply or renew online at dartaccess.dart.org. You will need to show proof of eligibility, and the card is mailed to you.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite o renueve en línea en dartaccess.dart.org. Tendrá que mostrar prueba de que califica, y la tarjeta le llega por correo.
records.notes: DART serves Plano in Collin County. Children under 5 ride free with a paying adult (up to two). Customer service 5 a.m.-midnight daily.

records.name: STAR Transit Dial-a-Ride (Reduced Fares for Seniors, Veterans, Disabled)
records.description_en: Public curb-to-curb bus rides to work, school, medical visits, shopping, and more in Kaufman and Rockwall counties. Seniors, veterans, and riders with disabilities pay half price.
records.description_es: Transporte público de puerta a puerta para ir al trabajo, la escuela, el médico, de compras y más en los condados de Kaufman y Rockwall. Personas mayores, veteranos y personas con discapacidad pagan la mitad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in the service area can ride. Reduced fares are for people 60+, veterans, and people with disabilities. Children under 12 ride free with an adult.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en el área de servicio puede usarlo. Las tarifas reducidas son para personas de 60 años o más, veteranos y personas con discapacidad. Los niños menores de 12 años viajan gratis con un adulto.
records.how_to_apply: Call (877) 631-5278 at least 1 business day (up to 2 weeks) ahead to book a ride. Scheduling hours are Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-4 p.m.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (877) 631-5278 por lo menos 1 día hábil antes (hasta 2 semanas antes) para reservar su viaje. El horario para reservar es de lunes a viernes, de 8 a.m. a 4 p.m. Hay ayuda en español.
records.hours: Rides most areas Mon-Fri 6 a.m.-6 p.m.; scheduling Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-4 p.m.
records.notes: Also serves Mesquite (until 8 p.m.), Balch Springs, Seagoville, DeSoto, Cedar Hill, Duncanville, Hutchins, Lancaster, Wilmer. Medicaid rides are booked through your health plan. Free Client Advocates can ride along to medical appointments.

records.name: Community Transit Service (CTS)
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb public bus rides from your home, job, or doctor's office. All buses are wheelchair accessible.
records.description_es: Transporte público de puerta a puerta desde su casa, trabajo o consultorio médico. Todos los autobuses tienen acceso para sillas de ruedas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the general public. Trips must start in Ellis or Navarro County. No special requirements.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a todo el público. Los viajes deben empezar en el condado de Ellis o Navarro. No hay requisitos especiales.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-800-834-1924 to schedule a ride. Buy a bus pass from your driver.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-800-834-1924 para reservar un viaje. Compre su pase de autobús con el chofer.
records.notes: Children can ride with an adult. Service animals are welcome. Fares vary by area. Office: 302 Hospital Dr, Corsicana, (903) 872-2401.

records.name: Span Transportation
records.description_en: Rides for people with special needs who have trouble getting around and use devices like wheelchairs, in Denton County.
records.description_es: Transporte para personas con necesidades especiales que tienen dificultad para moverse y usan aparatos como sillas de ruedas, en el condado de Denton.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For mobility-impaired people and people with special needs in Denton County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con movilidad limitada y necesidades especiales en el condado de Denton.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Rider Application on the Span website, or call (940) 382-1900.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de pasajero (Rider Application) en el sitio web de Span, o llame al (940) 382-1900.
records.notes: Fare/cost not stated on the page reviewed.

records.name: LifePath Systems (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: The public mental health and disability services center for Collin County. It offers crisis help, counseling, adult and youth services, and early childhood intervention.
records.description_es: El centro público de salud mental y servicios para discapacidades del condado de Collin. Ofrece ayuda en crisis, consejería, servicios para adultos y jóvenes, e intervención temprana para niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Collin County residents with mental health needs, intellectual or developmental disabilities, or young children with delays.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Collin con necesidades de salud mental, discapacidades intelectuales o del desarrollo, o niños pequeños con retrasos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 crisis line anytime, or call the McKinney outpatient clinic to get services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora, o llame a la clínica de McKinney para recibir servicios.
records.notes: 24/7 crisis line: 1-877-422-5939. Behavioral health: 972-422-5939 or 1-844-544-5939. Plano clinic: 7308 Alma Dr., Plano 75025. IDD office: 2295 Bloomdale Rd, McKinney, (972) 727-9133. Admin: (972) 562-0190.

records.name: Denton County MHMR Center (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: The public mental health and intellectual and developmental disability services center for Denton County, with a crisis line.
records.description_es: El centro público de salud mental y de servicios para discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo del condado de Denton, con una línea de crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Denton County residents needing mental health, crisis, or IDD services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Denton que necesitan servicios de salud mental, de crisis o para discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main line to start services. In a crisis, call the crisis line or 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea principal para empezar a recibir servicios. En una crisis, llame a la línea de crisis o al 988.
records.hours: Office Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m. (flexible hours available); crisis line 24/7
records.notes: Crisis line: 1-800-762-0157 or 988. Toll-free: 1-800-942-5808. TTY: 800-269-6233. Mailing address: PO Box 2346, Denton, TX 76202.

records.name: Lakes Regional Community Center - Rockwall and Kaufman Clinics
records.description_en: Mental health, substance use, and developmental disability services with clinics in Rockwall and Terrell.
records.description_es: Servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias y discapacidades del desarrollo, con clínicas en Rockwall y Terrell.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Rockwall and Kaufman counties who need mental health, substance use, or IDD services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de los condados de Rockwall y Kaufman que necesitan servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.how_to_apply: Call the local clinic. For a mental health crisis in Kaufman or Rockwall County, call the NTBHA crisis hotline 866-260-8000.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica local. En una crisis de salud mental en el condado de Kaufman o Rockwall, llame a la línea de crisis de NTBHA al 866-260-8000.
records.notes: Terrell (Kaufman County) MH clinic: 400 Airport Road, Terrell, 972-524-4159. Administration: 400 Airport Road, Terrell, 972-388-2000. 24/7 crisis line: 877-466-0660. Non-emergency toll-free 877-505-2537.

records.name: Pecan Valley Centers - Cleburne Clinic
records.organization: Pecan Valley Centers for Behavioral & Developmental Healthcare
records.description_en: Outpatient mental health care for adults, children, and teens in Johnson County, plus IDD services.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental para adultos, niños y adolescentes en el condado de Johnson, además de servicios para discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Johnson County residents who need mental health or developmental disability services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Johnson que necesitan servicios de salud mental o para discapacidades del desarrollo.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis and intake line (1-800-772-5987) to be screened, or call the Cleburne clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis y admisión (1-800-772-5987) para una evaluación, o llame a la clínica de Cleburne.
records.hours: 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; open until 7 p.m. every Tuesday
records.notes: Mental health crisis hotline and intake: 1-800-772-5987. IDD intake: 1-866-948-7198. Cleburne IDD office: 910 Granbury St., 817-766-5331.

records.name: Health Services of North Texas (Community Health Center)
records.description_en: A nonprofit community health center with clinics in Denton, Plano, and Wylie. It welcomes people with Medicaid, Medicare, or private insurance, and has a sliding fee for people without insurance.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario sin fines de lucro con clínicas en Denton, Plano y Wylie. Atiende a personas con Medicaid, Medicare o seguro privado, y tiene cobro según ingresos para personas sin seguro.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Uninsured patients can pay on a sliding scale based on income and family size.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a todos. Las personas sin seguro pueden pagar según sus ingresos y el tamaño de su familia.
records.how_to_apply: Call (940) 381-1501 or book online.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (940) 381-1501 o haga su cita en línea.
records.notes: Denton sites: 4304 and 4308 Mesa Dr; 3537 S I-35 E Ste 210; 306 N Loop 288 Ste 200. Wylie Children's clinic: 303 S Hwy 78 Ste 106, (972) 801-9689. Sliding fee covers visit, lab work, and injectables. Clinic hours were not listed online.

records.name: Denton County Public Health WIC
records.description_en: Free healthy foods, nutrition classes, and breastfeeding help for pregnant women, new mothers, and young children. WIC families can also get a $30 farmers market voucher.
records.description_es: Alimentos saludables gratis, clases de nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia para mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes y niños pequeños. Las familias de WIC también pueden recibir un vale de $30 para el mercado de agricultores.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, and young children who meet WIC income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes y niños pequeños que cumplan con los límites de ingresos de WIC.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at texaswic.org/apply, or call or visit a WIC office in Denton, Lewisville, or Carrollton.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en texaswic.org/apply, o llame o visite una oficina de WIC en Denton, Lewisville o Carrollton.
records.notes: Other offices: 190 N Valley Pkwy, Lewisville 75067; 3024 E Hebron Pkwy, Carrollton 75010 (WIC only). All offices: 940-349-2930, Mon-Fri 7:30 a.m.-5 p.m. Materials in English and Spanish.

records.name: Kaufman County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: Pays for basic health care like doctor visits, hospital care, lab work, and prescriptions for very low-income Kaufman County residents.
records.description_es: Paga atención médica básica como consultas, hospital, análisis de laboratorio y medicinas para residentes del condado de Kaufman con ingresos muy bajos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Kaufman County residents who do not qualify for other state or federal health programs, with monthly net income at or below 21% of the federal poverty guidelines and limited resources.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Kaufman que no califican para otros programas de salud estatales o federales, con ingresos netos mensuales de hasta el 21% de las guías federales de pobreza y pocos bienes.
records.how_to_apply: Download the application in English or Spanish from the county website and turn it in to the Courthouse Annex, or email indigenthealth@kaufmancounty.net.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud en inglés o español del sitio web del condado y entréguela en el Courthouse Annex, o mándela a indigenthealth@kaufmancounty.net.
records.notes: Resources may not exceed $2,000 ($3,000 if an aged or disabled relative lives in the home). Must have a medical need and plan to stay in Kaufman County. The coordinator speaks Spanish.

records.name: Collin County Veteran Services
records.description_en: Free help for veterans and their families applying for VA benefits, including disability claims, pensions, survivor benefits, and burial reimbursement.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para veteranos y sus familias al solicitar beneficios del VA, como reclamos por discapacidad, pensiones, beneficios para sobrevivientes y reembolso de gastos de entierro.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces and their dependents.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos de las Fuerzas Armadas de EE. UU. y sus dependientes.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email to schedule an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un correo para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m. and 1:00-4:00 p.m. (appointments required)
records.notes: Office closed 9/28/2026-10/02/2026 for training; during closure call Texas Veterans Commission (800) 252-8387 or VA (800) 827-1000. Email veteranservices@collincountytx.gov.
